title: Parallelizable Interior-Point ADMM for Block-Structured Nonconvex Programs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics simulation is an increasingly important computational primitive for AI, and local--global/ADMM splitting exposes its parallel structure but lacks matching finite-time convergence guarantees. We close this gap with two ADMM variants, Interior-Point ADMM (IP-ADMM), for block-structured nonconvex composite programs with smooth nonlinear inequality and affine constraints. A one-sided finite-activation wall keeps each constraint split state strictly feasible while the original-space infeasibility vanishes, giving closed-form constraint updates, one proximal call per objective block, and one equality-constrained quadratic consensus solve per iteration. \rev{To our knowledge, this makes IP-ADMM the first single-loop method that updates nonconvex inequality constraints locally and in parallel with finite-time convergence guarantees.} Ordinary IP-ADMM attains a CQ-free best-iterate weak-KKT rate of $O(K^{-1/3})$ or a banded Fritz--John

translated_title: 面向块结构非凸规划的可并行内点ADMM方法
translated_abstract: 物理仿真正成为人工智能中日益重要的计算基元，而局部-全局/ADMM分裂方法虽能揭示其并行结构，却缺乏相应的有限时间收敛保证。我们通过一种ADMM变体——内点ADMM（IP-ADMM）来填补这一空白，用于求解具有光滑非线性不等式约束和仿射约束的块结构非凸复合规划。一种单侧有限激活壁垒使每个约束分裂状态保持严格可行，同时原始空间中的不可行性逐渐消失，从而带来闭式约束更新、每个目标块仅一次近端调用，以及每次迭代只需一次等式约束二次一致性求解。据我们所知，这使得IP-ADMM成为首个能在有限时间收敛保证下，对非凸不等式约束进行局部且并行更新的单循环方法。普通IP-ADMM在无需约束规范条件下，最优迭代点达到 $O(K^{-1/3})$ 的弱KKT收敛速率，或获得带状Fritz–John……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出内点ADMM（IP-ADMM），这是首个在有限时间收敛保证下能够局部且并行更新非凸不等式约束的单循环算法，可用于求解含光滑非线性不等式与仿射约束的块结构非凸复合规划问题。
en_tdlr: We propose Interior-Point ADMM (IP-ADMM), the first single-loop method with finite-time convergence guarantees that locally and in parallel updates nonconvex inequality constraints for block-structured nonconvex composite programs with smooth nonlinear inequality and affine constraints.
